messages:
eli: quick heads-up — ran a pass of the new dynamic chunking classifier on canary s1 at 10:15. saw weird tail latency bump after ~1.5h
sasha: link to run? logs?
eli: https://perf.redwood/canary/1749132460
eli: summary: classifier is splitting requests into short/med/long by prompt-length+decode-rate. admission used token_budget=24 for short, 48 for med, 128 for long. started stable but then tail p99 increased +120ms
jasmin: any kv cache miss spikes?
eli: yes — KV warmup metric shows >30% miss rate spike within first 30s of a burst
eli: pasted perf snippet:
```
[2025-04-06T10:30:21Z] gpu0 util 92% kernel=matmul_fast fallback_count=12
[2025-04-06T10:30:21Z] kv_cache.miss_rate 0.33 evictions=42
[2025-04-06T10:30:21Z] batcher.queue_len 11 admission=token_budget
```
ken: fallback_count=12 is suspicious — which kernel fallback path triggered?
eli: kernel selector logs show fallback to matmul_generic when sequence_len variance > 64 and decode_rate < 8 tok/s
sasha: so fast-decoding short prompts ended up being treated as slow due to variance? that'd inflate KV churn
jasmin: might be the classifier's decode-rate bucket boundary — what are thresholds?
eli: current thresholds: decode_rate_buckets = [0-4, 5-12, 13+] prompt_len_buckets=[0-64,65-256,257+]
eli: admission policy snippet used:
```
admission:
  short: {token_budget: 24, max_batch_wait_ms: 8}
  med:   {token_budget: 48, max_batch_wait_ms: 12}
  long:  {token_budget:128, max_batch_wait_ms: 20}
```
ken: suggestion: lower short token_budget to 16 and reduce max_batch_wait to 6ms for short. also add KV prefetch for short-hot path
jasmin: also consider smoothing decode_rate using EWMA over 200ms to avoid transient misclassification
sasha: +1 to EWMA. we should also avoid kernel fallback by adding a sequence_len_stddev check before selector flips
eli: I can roll patch: classifier EWMA window + reduce short token_budget + KV prefetch hint for short. plan to canary tonight 23:00
perf-bot: scheduled canary rollout for eng-runtime/canary-s1 at 2025-04-06T23:00:00Z by eli
ken: quick question — how will we measure success? define clear metrics
eli: target: reduce p99 tail by >= 80ms vs baseline; kv_cache.miss_rate peak <15% during bursts; fallback_count <=3
jasmin: if we hit only the KV target but p99 unchanged, we should iterate on kernel selection thresholds
sasha: tagging @ops oncall for watch at rollout
eli: thanks — will post followup with dashboards after the canary
